meta_description: Press resources for Silver & Elegant — brand summary, founder biography, and editorial assets.
brand_summary_body:
SILVER & ELEGANT is an independent London sculptural jewellery studio, founded in January 2025. Conceived through architectural rigor and computational design, pieces are engineered for single-artisan physical execution in Istanbul’s Grand Bazaar. The brand creates Future Heirlooms — sculptural objects crafted for permanence over seasons.

The studio served as the official jewellery partner for Paul Costelloe's London Fashion Week AW26 opening show. It holds Featured Designer status on Not Just A Label (NJAL), has been selected for Wolf & Badger Editor's Picks, named a Finalist for Business Innovation at the SME Hertfordshire Business Awards 2026, and featured in Flanelle Magazine and KALTBLUT Magazine.
founder_bio_body:
Esen Tunalı Sarı, FRSA, is the Founder and Creative Director of SILVER & ELEGANT.

A Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts, her design practice bridges architectural precision, computational form, and traditional metal discipline. Shaped by living and working across Bulgaria, Türkiye, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom, she directs the London-based studio with a focus on structural permanence and visual fidelity.
